 ORDER

By way of this petition, the petitioner has prayed for the grant of bail in FIR No.09/2022, dated 07.02.2022, under Sections 376, 323 and 506 of the IPC, registered with Women Police Station Baddi, District, Solan, H.P.
2.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Status report stands filed, which is ordered to be taken on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that in .
the light of the fact that the petitioner is in custody for the last more than 3 years, the present petition be allowed and the petitioner be released on bail.

3. On the other hand, learned Additional Advocate of General has submitted that taking into consideration the fact that the allegations against the petitioner are of committal of a heinous offence and further taking into consideration his antecedents the rt present petition be dismissed.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and have also gone through the status report.
5. It is pertinent to mention that earlier also this Court in Cr.MP(M) No.1767 of 2022 filed by the petitioner had rejected his bail application on 16.08.2022 by passing a speaking order.

6. This Court took note of the fact in its earlier order that there were other FIRs registered against the petitioner including under Section 376 of the Indian Penal code as well as the provisions of POCSO Act.

A perusal of the status report filed by the State reiterates this fact and, therefore, in the About 36 Years S/O Hukm vs Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120590044/
2 light of this fact that the petitioner is not only a habitual offender but is facing prosecution for commission of grave and heinous offences including offences punishable under Sections 354 of the Indian Penal Code as well as POCSO Act.

7. In the light of all these facts on record, this Court sees .
no reason to show any indulgence to the present petitioner and, accordingly, the bail petition is dismissed.
